component.name: Pocket Sense
component.summary: Private, offline money tracker in English and Arabic

description.p: Pocket Sense tracks your income, spending, accounts, budgets, bills and loans without signing up and without the internet, in any of 69 currencies. Everything stays in an encrypted database on your computer. It leaves only as an encrypted backup, or, if you turn on sync, encrypted to your own paired devices on your Wi-Fi.

ul.li: No sign-in, no servers, no ads, no analytics
Encrypted with SQLCipher, with the key kept in your desktop keyring, or behind a passphrase if there is none
Home: monthly totals, a 30-day spending chart, and spending by category, merchant and weekday
Accounts, transfers, budgets, recurring bills with reminders, loans and savings circles
Encrypted backups, and CSV import and export
Sync with your phone or another computer over your local network
Full Arabic interface, right to left

screenshot.caption: Home: monthly totals, a 30-day spending chart, and spending by category and by merchant
Income vs spending over 6 months, this month against last, and spending by weekday
Savings circles: where you stand in each, and the next payment
